definitions: A semiconductor device that converts light into an electrical charge and stores it in a series of coupled capacitors.
An integrated circuit used in digital cameras, video cameras, and other optical devices to capture images.
examples: The telescope uses a Charged-Coupled Device to capture images of distant galaxies.
Early digital cameras relied heavily on Charged-Coupled Devices for image acquisition.
Scientific instruments often incorporate a Charged-Coupled Device for high-sensitivity light detection.
